name: Mano.ma — Prix Femme de Ménage au Maroc (guide tarifaire national)
methodology_notes: Aggregator/guide platform. Presents market-observed ranges by city and format. No transaction volume disclosed. Reasonably structured.
limitations: Self-published content; no stated methodology for how ranges were derived. Likely editorial/survey-based.

name: Adom.ma — Femme de ménage Casablanca (marketplace platform, June 2026)
methodology_notes: Active platform with 60+ verified cleaners. States tarifs observed on platform in June 2026. Provides by-property-type ranges and hourly rate. Structured pricing table.
limitations: Casablanca-only. Platform commission not disclosed. May reflect premium segment.

name: O2 Maroc — Tarifs femme de ménage Casablanca 2025
methodology_notes: Established Moroccan home-services company (28 ans stated). Tarifs on website but devis-required for final price. Mentions 45 MAD/h as starting rate.
limitations: Actual grid replaced by devis flow; headline rate only. Premium provider positioning.

name: Nettoyage-Casablanca.com — Combien coûte un service de nettoyage à Casablanca
methodology_notes: Comprehensive tariff breakdown including hourly, residential per-intervention, post-construction per m², upholstery per item, glass cleaning.
limitations: Provider SEO content; no methodology for derivation.

name: Nettoyage-Rabat.com — Prix nettoyage appartement à Rabat
methodology_notes: Regional provider with structured pricing by property size. Standard, deep-clean, and post-construction tiers documented.
limitations: Provider SEO content. Advertised prices may differ from billed.

name: NettoyageMaroc.com — Prix nettoyage appartement Casablanca
methodology_notes: Provider with full-service offering (regular, deep, post-construction, pre/post-move). Pricing ranges by size class.

name: NettoyageMaroc.com — Coût nettoyage après travaux Casablanca
methodology_notes: Focused specifically on post-construction. Covers complexity levels, material types, specialist equipment.
limitations: Price not fully disclosed (devis-required); qualitative factors well described.

name: O2 Maroc — Tarif nettoyage canapé, tapis Casablanca 2026
methodology_notes: Full explicit price grid. Per-item by seat count for sofas, by size tier for rugs, per-face for mattresses, per-m² for carpets. Detailed and structured. Detachage, désodorisation included.
limitations: Single provider. May not represent all-market pricing.

name: Hany.ma — Nettoyage canapé à domicile Maroc (nationwide platform)
methodology_notes: Multi-city platform (Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tanger, Agadir, Fès). Provides price ranges by seat count, mattress size, rug per m². States these are 'indicatifs prix moyens'. Describes injection-extraction method.
limitations: Ranges not single prices. Platform commission model not stated.

name: Experts-Doulle-Clean.ma — Tarifs nettoyage canapé/tapis/matelas
methodology_notes: Published à partir de price grid: matelas 150 MAD, tapis 150 MAD, canapé 300 MAD, chaise 40 MAD. Déplacement inclus stated.
limitations: À partir de prices only (minimum bait-risk). Single provider.

name: O2 Maroc — Nettoyage après déménagement Casablanca
methodology_notes: Confirms service offering (pre/post-move cleaning). Materials and products supplied by provider. Devis-required pricing.
limitations: No price disclosed; confirms scope only.

methodology_notes: Includes post-construction 12–25 MAD/m² range, carpet 20–40 MAD/m², sofa 70–250 MAD/item, glass 200–800 MAD for small surfaces.
limitations: Aggregate guide content from provider website.

name: FIXEO fixeo-pricing-marocain.js — nettoyage métier block

name: FIXEO fixeo-profile-v2a.js — nettoyage métier from price
